name: Exa
summary: Exa is a web search API built for AI applications and agents. It runs its own crawler and index and uses embedding models it trains itself, and offers search, page contents, answers, scheduled monitors and an asynchronous research agent. Developers use it to ground LLMs in current web results.
facts: Own crawler and index, 500B+ URLs tracked (vendor-reported)
$250M Series C led by a16z at $2.2B valuation (May 2026)
goodFor: Semantic search for agents and RAG
Retrieving full page text along with results
Async deep research and list building
watchOut: Usage-based pricing adds up with deep search and agent runs
Speed and quality claims are vendor-reported
